fusions.name: Lead Bull
fusions.desc: Leads with a lowered head, which deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Milling Stampede
fusions.desc: Tramples every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 8 damage and costs you 4% of your maximum health. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Rich Milk
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazing Pace
fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
